MockingBatwing — Motorola Razr launcher + SystemUI + System Framework customization (LSPosed): icons, grid, labels, status bar, control center, CorePatch, and launcher layout backup/restore.
Manage launcher and SystemUI settings in one screen. Settings are saved to shared preferences.
Enable the module in LSPosed and add com.motorola.launcher3, com.android.systemui and android to the scope. A device reboot is required the first time.
Clock, media card, PIN entry and shortcuts
Clock, notification placement, media card, PIN auto-confirm, shortcuts and camera gesture
Select the category you want to configure. Each card opens its dedicated settings screen.
Icon shape, labels, folders, home grid and widget resizing
Status bar, notification bar ordering and control center
Showing the scopes whose hooks were actually detected as loaded.
No scopes are currently hooked (module disabled or no scope configured)
Disable FLAG_SECURE, disable camera shutter sound, signature verification bypass, downgrade allowed
FLAG_SECURE %1$s · Shutter sound off %2$s · Signature bypass %3$s · Downgrade %4$s
Shows the hook log of the launcher and SystemUI. Tap refresh to load the latest output.
Removes the resize restrictions on long press and allows resizing in 1-cell steps.
Show the Dock on the cover screen
Shows the Hotseat on the outer display.
Cover screen only. Adds at least 20dp side insets and 28dp rounded corners to the background. Reuses background width and height settings without changing the icon count or layout area.
Adds a translucent gradient and reflective edges to the cover Dock. Mutually exclusive with frosted glass.

Enabling either style makes the stock Dock background transparent and displays glass at the same position and size. Only one style can be enabled at a time. Disable both to restore the stock background. Does not blur the wallpaper.
Styles folder icons as glass and adds a container using the notification and control center material to open folders. Background blur follows the shared slider.
Gives the cover-screen Dock a frosted look using a translucent gradient and a subtle border. Does not blur the wallpaper or icons.
Settings are saved immediately. Restart the target process to apply them.
Showing the scopes whose hooks were actually detected as loaded.
Makes labels transparent in Workspace, All Apps, folders and the Dock.
Choose SYSTEM to restore the standard mask. Clearing the icon cache is recommended after changing the shape.
Shows up to 9 app icons in a 3×3 preview. The opened folder uses a fixed 4×4 grid (max 16) aligned from the top-left.

This app needs root access to apply settings, restart the launcher and read module scopes.

Grant superuser access to this app (io.github.devola_sun.motorolatweak) in KernelSU / SukiSU / Magisk, then tap Check again.

If access is already granted, close and reopen this app.
Rows, columns and Dock icons range from 4 to 10.
Makes each home screen cell a 1:1 square and balances the remaining space above/below and left/right.
Move media card to the top row

Places a square media card beside connectivity, with brightness on the left and volume on the right below it. The lower-left area contains flashlight and auto-rotate, with a two-tile-wide Bedtime mode button underneath.
Requires the SystemUI scope in LSPosed. Applies in portrait and table mode. The 2×2 connectivity card can be configured under SystemUI.
Status bar settings are applied after restarting SystemUI.
Shows seconds (hh:mm:ss) in the status bar clock.
Hides the percentage and shows only the battery icon.
Hides VoLTE, HD voice, VoWiFi, NFC and dual-SIM indicators.
Replaces Wi-Fi with a fan shape and signal with 4-bar iOS style.
Adjusts the margins of the main (punch-hole) and cover displays.
Status bar changes apply after restarting SystemUI; charging control applies after a device reboot.
Changes the status bar battery icon shape.
Switch between always visible, hidden and inside the icon. "Inside icon" is drawn as a pill.
Uses Motorola adaptive charging to stop charging at the selected level.
Select 60–100%. Not applied on devices without Motorola charging control.
Disables the battery over-temperature shutdown. Use at your own risk.
Charging and temperature control live in system_server; reboot the device after changing them.
Ignores FLAG_SECURE so protected screens can be captured and recorded.
Security-protected screens (banking apps etc.) become capturable. Enable only when needed.
Allows overwriting an installed app with an APK signed by a different key
Disables the shutter sound that is enabled in the Japanese region or with a Japanese SIM inserted.
Allows overwriting an installed app with a lower versionCode
Installs while ignoring digest verification errors
※ A device reboot or soft reboot (Zygote restart) is required to apply system framework changes.
Avoids crashes and boot loops when flags are enabled on devices other than the razr fold. Error logs are force-written to /sdcard/Download/Errorlog.
Swaps them to brightness on the left and volume on the right, and syncs their heights.
Notification, control center and folder background blur

Applies the same percentage to the native background blur in the notification center, control center and open folders. 100% is the system strength; 0% disables blur. Independent of Liquid Glass. Folder changes apply the next time a folder opens.
Uses the notification cards’ backdrop blur, translucency and reflective edges without changing switch or slider sizes, positions or interactions. Independent of the notification blur setting.
Off by default. Falls back to translucent glass when the device disables blur.
A 2×2 grid of Wi-Fi, data, Bluetooth and airplane mode.
Long press and drag to reorder. Use the ⇄ button to move items between groups.
Press \"Restart SystemUI to apply\" after changing.
Saves the home screen, Dock and folder layout. Restoring stops the launcher and replaces its database.
Reboot the device after the first install and after module updates. Use the restart buttons after changing settings.

Change settings and press \"Restart launcher to apply\".
Clearing the icon cache and restarting the launcher to apply the shape…

Adjust from 100 to 200% in 1% steps. 100% restores the native size. Independent of Keep large clock and Liquid Glass; always-on display is not enlarged. Higher values or some clock styles may cause clipping or overlap with notifications and widgets.

Adds translucency, gradients and reflective edges to clock digits, without actual wallpaper refraction or blur. Keeps the clock size, font and position unchanged, independently of Keep large clock. Restores stock rendering when off or in always-on display. Some clock styles are unsupported.

Prevents theme-based artwork dimming on lock-screen, notification-center, control-center and Dynamic Island-style media cards. Backgrounds and controls keep their theme. Turn off to restore the stock appearance.

Uses the same compact layout for lock-screen and notification-center cards and expanded Dynamic Island-style playback popups. Album art and track information appear above a straight seek bar with times at both ends and a translucent background track; white playback controls and the output picker below. Reuses the native player; extra actions appear only when provided by the media app. Keeps the Liquid glass setting and leaves the control center unchanged. Turn off to restore stock layout.
Solid white lock above the clock

Draws a solid white lock above the clock and hides the original bottom lock indicator. Reflects locked/unlocked state. The top icon is display-only. Always-on display is unchanged. Turn off to restore the stock bottom indicator.
Do not tuck away silent notifications
Keeps silent notifications as cards in the notification center instead of an icon-only bar. Does not change sound, vibration or importance. Turn off to restore stock behavior.

Gives notifications and lock-screen media cards translucent surfaces with subtle reflective edges. Control-center media cards keep stock background blur while retaining layout and size customizations. Notification placement and the normal unstacked shade list are unchanged. Turn off to restore stock backgrounds.

Requires the SystemUI scope in LSPosed. Stock notification actions and privacy settings are preserved. Stacking is disabled during TalkBack touch exploration. When blur is unavailable or disabled by battery saver, a translucent surface and outline are used instead. Some ROMs are unsupported.

Keeps the large clock and moves lock-screen notifications into a bottom stack. Scroll vertically to see two or more cards. Turn off to restore the stock clock behavior and notification position. Does not change notification shade placement.

This switch controls notification placement and stacking. Backgrounds are controlled separately by Liquid glass. Touch exploration uses an unstacked list. Some ROMs are unsupported; placement, widget overlap and interaction require device testing.
Swipe from right edge to open camera
Swipe left from the right edge of the lock screen to open the lock-screen camera.

Gives the bottom-left and bottom-right lock-screen buttons translucent backgrounds with reflective edges. Phone and Bluetooth device battery widgets below the clock use their stock backgrounds. Works independently of notification/playback card settings and keeps button icons sharp. Turn off to restore stock button backgrounds.
Applies to both sides. 100% is the system size. Enlarges the buttons, icons and touch targets.
When blur is unavailable or disabled by battery saver, uses the same translucent surface and outline as notification cards.
Switches the display language of the app. Changes apply immediately.
Hide the numeric device-lock PIN confirm button and authenticate only after the selected number of digits. Turn off to restore stock behavior.

Always select the length of your current PIN (4–16 digits). This does not change your PIN. SIM PINs and text passwords are excluded. A known length mismatch preserves stock behavior. If length metadata is unavailable, the selected value is used: an incorrect selection causes authentication failures. In that case, turn this off and apply using the button below. Failed-attempt limits and lockout delays are unchanged.
Customize the Moto widget clock, date and weather on your home screen
Liquid Glass clock, date and weather

Adds translucency, gradients and reflective edges to the home screen Moto widget clock, date, weather icons and descriptions, temperature, city name and related information. Off by default. Does not change size, layout, backgrounds or the lock screen clock. No actual wallpaper refraction or blur. Turning this off restores stock rendering. Requires the com.motorola.launcher3 LSPosed scope. Unrecognized display elements keep stock rendering.
Restart Moto Widgets and launcher to apply
